# 1AM Governance

Public distribution of the approved 1AM Manifesto v1.1 and 1AM CODEX v1.0.
Repository: https://github.com/vitaliiarcanus-web6/1am-governance

Canonical normative texts:
- Manifesto: manifesto/1AM_Manifesto_v1.1_CANONICAL.txt
- CODEX: codex/1AM_CODEX_v1.0_CANONICAL.txt

Machine readable index: governance.json
CODEX decision model: codex/decision-model.yaml
Integrity and provenance: manifesto/SHA256.txt, manifesto/provenance.json, codex/SHA256.txt, codex/provenance.json

The canonical TXT files prevail over all summaries and derivatives. Public access does not imply adoption of the CODEX by external AI systems.
